name: Rohan K.
problemsFindingInfo: Timings and whether wheelchair accessibility is available are rarely mentioned online.
accessibilityProblem: Most toilet blocks have steep curbs without ramps or handrails.
suggestions: Install clear tactile signage and keep the digital directory updated with exact gate timings.
comments: Great initiative by B.Sc. CS students to map our local services.

name: Sunita M.
problemsFindingInfo: Night chemists are hard to locate during late night emergencies without calling multiple numbers.
accessibilityProblem: Footpaths outside clinics are obstructed, making it hard for senior citizens.
suggestions: Highlight verified 24/7 stores with direct phone buttons.
comments: Essential for elderly residents living alone.

name: Anonymous Resident
problemsFindingInfo: Confusion about which ward office handles my pin code.
accessibilityProblem: Lack of parking and narrow corridors in civic offices.
suggestions: Add a pin-code based ward office locator tool.
comments: Valuable research for community civic tech.
